scope: BMO problems with ambiguous combinatorics or graph-like signals

problems.statement_en:
Let q be a positive rational number. Two ants are initially at the same point X in the plane. In the
n-th minute ( n = 1 ; 2; : : :) each of them chooses whether to walk due north, east, south or west and
then walks the distance of qn metres. After a whole number of minutes, they are at the same point in
the plane (not necessarily X), but have not taken exactly the same route within that time. Determine
all possible values of q.
